title: McCracken roundabout (Adelaide Rd / Hindmarsh Rd / Port Elliot Rd) by Bunnings and the service stations
why: Asked about by residents: Bunnings, Mobil and OTR are 10-30 m away, Caltex McCracken about 40 m. Includes the nearby side streets onto Hindmarsh Rd (Antrim St, Down St).
junctions_used: adelaide_hindmarsh_portelliot (roundabout), Hindmarsh Rd / Antrim St (node 795603899), Hindmarsh Rd / Down St (cluster_11195084600_795603873)

scenario_descriptions.bp: Brent's package (four-lane ring road, two-lane McCracken roundabout, roundabout slip lanes)
